title: Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity hosts and standalone plugin projection
summary: Adds `gemini` and `antigravity` as supported workspace and plugin hosts across `@inventarch/cli`, `@inventarch/distribution`, `@inventarch/runtime`, `@inventarch/steward-hook`, and `@inventarch/workspace-runtime`; compiles standalone zero-IA-dependency plugins via `ia project <host> --product plugin` with progressive-disclosure router skills, static OPAL packets, and standalone `@hook` guards; and reuses opened workspace snapshots across `ia_kb_*` queries in `@inventarch/kb` and `@inventarch/mcp-door`.
